result.summary: Found 2 major issues: horizontal card overflow in carousels causing content truncation, and bottom content cut-off affecting visual completeness.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right side of the screen, and its name appears truncated mid-word
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards are fully visible or implement proper spacing/padding. If a carousel is intended, add visual indicators (dots or arrows) and ensure text doesn't get cut off. Consider adjusting card width or adding proper overflow handling.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20% discount) is cut off at the bottom of the visible viewport, making it impossible to see the restaurant name, rating, or delivery details without scrolling
issues.suggestion: Adjust bottom padding/margins to ensure content is fully visible or clearly scrollable. Add more whitespace below the last visible element, or implement proper viewport constraints so important content isn't hidden.
